name: Refactor
when: restructuring, renaming, cleaning up or simplifying code without changing what it does

stages.prompt: Run the project's tests first so you know the starting state. Then plan the refactor: what moves or changes and in what order, keeping behaviour identical. Do not change any file. Call finish with the plan and the test result before any change.
Carry out the refactor in small steps, running the tests after each. Do not change behaviour and do not add features. Call finish with what you changed.
Run the tests and read the diff (`git diff HEAD`). Start your finish summary with PASS if the tests still pass and behaviour is unchanged, or FAIL followed by what broke or changed.
